text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bump into Air Shakur while walking
through the
shopping district one
evening.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with that face? Is the idea of me
buying
food really so weird to you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just ran outta the ramune candy I use to

supplement my glucose levels. I've been
running
out strangely quick, recently...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it can't be a good
sign that
my brain is demanding excess
glucose. I've gotta
be careful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's possible that Air Shakur is still
fatigued from her recent races. It looks
like I should probably
rethink her
upcoming race schedule.
